summary: Implemented and build-verified Phases 1-3 of the backstop polkit fix: added a narrow security.polkit.extraConfig rule granting root org.freedesktop.login1.suspend-ignore-inhibit in modules/system/power.nix, committed tests/battery-suspend-backstop-offline.sh with a stub caveat header and one non-stubbed pkcheck assertion (16/16 passing, idempotent), and corrected two false polkit-authorization claims in docs/no-sleep-agents.md and docs/testing.md. Phase 4 (live end-to-end verification) is blocked on the user: it requires sudo, a NixOS generation activation, and a real suspend/resume cycle that this agent must not run. Build-green, closure-grep-green, and offline-suite-green are explicitly reported as insufficient evidence that the backstop can now suspend the machine.
